posts.title: How we speak about AI affects our perception of it
posts.description: If it looks like a duck and quacks like a duck, it might just be a robot that looks and quacks like a duck. I'm not a fan of how we talk about AI. Specifically, I think using anthropomorphic language to describe and discuss AI is harmful . We use non-it pronouns for it. posts.title: Designing in public, iteration 4
posts.description: My previous favicon was a poorly drawn letter H, in orange, with weird antialiasing. We can't have that. So a new icon it is. I still wanted an H. So I tried a bunch of things. An H, an A, and a Y, stacked. Stacked vertically, stacked oddly against each other, stacked like jumbled puzzle pieces. All black and white. Then some color from the website (which is still only Prot 's ef-dream palette ).
